entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor I bought. And I don't want a runaround, I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number, please?
The name is Mike Peterson. Order number is... VF88-12-9034. Just process the return.
Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not a fault, it works fine. I just don't want it anymore. It's been sitting in the box for a month. It's a piece of junk I don't need.
I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see the item was delivered 35 days ago. One moment while I review the return eligibility for you.

Thirty-five days? So what?! Don't you tell me it's **too late**! If you're about to give me some garbage excuse about **hygiene** or **sanitation** for an item I barely touched, I want your manager right now! This is ridiculous! What kind of **policy** are you people running?!
Sir, I understand your concern, there's no need for a manager. Let me just confirm the details. I'm looking at our official return **policy** right now for your specific product.

Okay, thank you for holding. It looks like you're in luck. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only at day 35, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Wait, really? Ninety days? Are you sure about that?
Yes, absolutely. My system is showing a 10-day return window for this item. I can go ahead and process that for you immediately and email you a pre-paid return shipping label.
Oh. Well, that's... that's better. Okay. Yeah, go ahead and send the label. A full refund, right?

That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method as soon as we receive the item back at our warehouse. The email with the label and instructions has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mike?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
